key_insights: Speaker was admitted to a four-year university CS bachelor's program after initially planning to complete an associate's degree first due to cost/debt concerns
Speaker was uncertain whether a course needed to complete the associate's degree would transfer, illustrating a real transfer-credit uncertainty some students face
Speaker cites personal debt-avoidance as the original reason for choosing the associate's-then-transfer path over directly attending a four-year program
Speaker describes self-study (Udemy courses, books on algorithms/data structures, JavaScript, web development) as parallel prep alongside enrollment
notable_or_distinctive: Personal, meandering vlog update with no admissions-process insight beyond one individual's transfer/debt decision; largely off-topic for a knowledge base on admissions strategy.
reliability_notes: No admissions-office or counselor perspective; content is a personal life update with an unresolved, uncertain transfer-credit situation, not generalizable advice. Low relevance.
